headline: The proposed experience gives me the usable-condition details I need before walking over, with clear dates and unknowns.
nice_to_have: Show a clearly labeled example listing so I can see how quickly I could scan paper, floor condition, usable stalls, and observation times.
in_character_reaction: Is there paper and a usable stall? This proposal puts those details where I need them and tells me when someone actually saw them. I like being able to look without registering and leaving a short report only if I want to.
